title: Director of Quality
text:
DuPage Machine Products a high volume, high precision metal turning machine shop, is seeking a Quality Director to maintain and enhance the organization’s Quality Assurance activities by planning, implementing and evaluating quality related resources, equipment, software, policies, programs and practices.

The successful candidate will oversee the entire company’s quality system at the strategic level and monitor the day to day quality operations by directing multiple reporting engineers, technicians and supervisors. The appropriate candidate will interact with outside customers and potential clients. This individual will monitor, support and delegate inspection activities, personnel, PPAP, rework, and ISO activities.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

* **Bachelor of Science degree in a technical field**
* **In-depth knowledge of Quality Systems, including statistics and computer skills**
* **Problem solving and team building skills**
* **Customer and supplier response and interaction skills**
* **Oral and written communications skills**
* **10 years of Quality Management experience**
* **CQM and/or CQE certifications preferred.**

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: \* Deal professionally with customers, suppliers and internal departments as required to resolve quality issues.

* Work closely with production personnel to improve productivity and quality.
* Develop, maintain, and implement the DuPage Machine Products Quality System
* Set direction of the quality program
* Develop and implement long range strategy for Quality Department
* Upgrade Quality Assurance personnel, equipment, methods and procedures
* Establish organization-wide Quality Performance Measurement and Reporting Systems
* Define Quality Policies, Procedures, Work Instructions and Forms
* Supervision of personnel in the Quality Department
* Hire, review and terminate personnel in the Quality Department
* Work with Engineering on developing Quality Standards
* Purchase Quality related equipment and outside services
* Monitor Customer Quality Requirements
* Establish relationships with our customers
* Establish relationships with our suppliers
* Establish relationships with Operations personnel
* Member of Management Team
* Member of the Material Review Board
* ISO Management Representative
* Define ISO Internal Audit Schedule
* Train Internal ISO Auditors

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* ISO 9001: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person
